subject: SOC 2 Type II — supplemental log correlation & pseudonymization sample request
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medixone.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental control artifacts

Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff earlier. Our security/audit team kicked off the SOC 2 Type II review and we have a couple of follow-ups where we need supplemental artifacts beyond the final report. Can you confirm delivery or let us know if you need any clarifications on the items below?

Requested artifacts (scope: audit period Mar 1 2025 — Feb 28 2026 unless you indicate otherwise):
- Sample session retention slices for interactive API sessions (raw session events but with PII removed) covering three non-contiguous days: one weekday, one weekend day, and one high-traffic day.
- MFA event logs (success/failure) for privileged accounts during the audit period.
- Device-binding / device fingerprinting events correlated to session IDs for the sampled days.
- Pseudonymization mapping used to replace real user IDs in audit extracts (we prefer redacted mapping with consistent pseudonyms to test correlation, not full cleartext identifiers).
- KMS rotation records (key rotation timestamps and signed rotation metadata) for any keys used in token encryption.

Also: if your SOC 2 Type II report period doesn't exactly align with our audit period above, we will need a bridge letter that states controls continuity for the missing window.

Delivery preferences: secure SFTP or encrypted Google Drive link. We can accept CSV/NDJSON for session events and a redacted JSON mapping for pseudonymization. Any bulk artifacts should be accompanied by a short README describing fields and timezones.

Could you let us know by EOD Wednesday (May 6) whether you can provide these artifacts and an estimated delivery timeline?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Security & Compliance Manager
MedixOne Health

Attachments: none
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medixone.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental control artifacts

Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. We can supply the requested artifacts; below is what we propose and a short timeline. Karthik (cc'd) will prepare the exports and a README describing fields and redaction approach.

What we'll provide (initial proposal):
- auth_session_sample.csv: sampled session events for three days (weekday: 2025-11-12, weekend: 2025-12-21, high-traffic: 2026-01-15). Columns will include session_id (pseudonymized), start_ts, end_ts, device_fingerprint_hash, region, api_route, lat_ms, error_flag.
- mfa_events.ndjson: all MFA success/failure events for privileged accounts during the audit period (timestamps in UTC).
- device_binding_slice.csv: device binding events linked to pseudonymized session_id for the sampled days.
- pseudonymization-mapping-redacted.json: mapping file with consistent pseudonyms (we will redact any direct PII but provide stable pseudonyms so you can correlate across artifacts).
- kms-rotation-log.txt: signed rotation metadata for keys used in token/encryption flows.

We will upload artifacts to an encrypted Drive folder and share a link. ETA: initial upload for the sample set by Friday, May 8 EOD, full set by May 12 if no further requests. If Hawk Security requires different days or additional metadata fields, let us know ASAP.

Also confirming: if our SOC 2 Type II report period differs, we'll provide a bridge letter. Please confirm the exact format you need for the mapping file (redacted-with-stable-ids is what we'd propose).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medixone.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental control artifacts

Jonas / Priya — quick technical note on the extracts so Priya's team knows what to expect: 

- auth_session_sample.csv will be UTF-8 CSV, comma-delimited, header included. session_id will be a stable pseudonym of the form user_XXXX where XXXX is a truncated hash. We will include a checksum column for traceability.
- For mfa_events.ndjson, events will include: event_ts (ISO8601 UTC), user_pseudonym, factor_type, result (SUCCESS/FAIL), source_ip (CIDR / redacted), device_hash.
- Device fingerprints are one-way hashes; we will include a device_meta column with high-level device category (mobile/desktop) rather than raw UA strings to reduce PII.
- Pseudonymization-mapping-redacted.json will include original_user_id: REDACTED, pseudonym: user_XXXX, replaced_at_ts, replacement_method: (hashing + salt). We will explicitly exclude email addresses and full names.
- KMS rotation logs: we can export rotation timestamps and the signed rotation certificate; we cannot export full private material.

Potential constraints: key rotation evidence for an HSM-backed key may require legal review; if so, ETA could slip to May 14. If MedixOne needs cryptographic proofs beyond signed rotation metadata, tell us and we'll route to legal/security for a short exception.

I'll begin assembly today and post the Drive link once the first CSV is ready.

—Karthik
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Hawk Security Audit Team <audit@hawksecurity.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medixone.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental control artifacts

Jonas / team —

Quick confirmations from the audit side:
- Redacted-but-stable pseudonyms are perfect. Our objective is to verify correlations across artifacts (sessions, MFA, device bindings) without receiving PII.
- For sampled days, please provide both local timezone timestamps and UTC; indicate the timezone used in the README.
- For KMS rotation: signed rotation metadata is sufficient. If you can include the rotation policy document (redacted) that explains rotation cadence that helps our control narrative.
- Please provide an assurance statement (brief bridge letter) if your SOC 2 report period does not fully cover Mar 1 2025 — Feb 28 2026. The bridge letter can be concise and should state which controls are unchanged and cite any compensating controls.
- Delivery: secure SFTP is preferred for large exports; Google Drive is acceptable if the folder is encrypted and link is shared with explicit access.

Checklist for artifact contents (for clarity):
1) session sample CSV with pseudonymized session_id + timezone info
2) ndjson MFA events with result codes and user pseudonyms
3) device binding slice with device_hash + session_id mapping
4) redacted pseudonymization mapping file (stable IDs)
5) signed KMS rotation metadata + rotation policy doc (redacted OK)

If you can upload the first package by May 8 that will be great. If any of the items are not available, please explicitly note that in the README and provide an alternative.

Thanks — Hawk Audit Team
Hawk Security (on behalf of MedixOne)

Attachments: none
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medixone.com>, Hawk Security Audit Team <audit@hawksecurity.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental control artifacts

Thanks everyone — short update and plan: 

1) We will provide the initial sample package by EOD Friday, May 8. That package will include auth_session_sample.csv, device_binding_slice.csv, and pseudonymization-mapping-redacted.json.
2) MFA ndjson and KMS rotation metadata will follow by May 12. If the HSM-backed rotation docs require legal clearance, we will flag it immediately; current ETA for that specific item is May 14.
3) Delivery method: we will upload to an encrypted Drive folder and send a shared link to the addresses on this thread. For the large ndjson file we will also post it to an SFTP drop and share credentials via our standard secure channel.
4) Bridge letter: our SOC 2 Type II report covers Apr 1 2025 — Mar 31 2026; we will provide a short bridge letter that states control continuity for Mar 1 2025 — Feb 28 2026 and note no material control changes. Draft will be uploaded with the artifacts.

Attachments to expect in the first upload: auth_session_sample.csv (CSV), pseudonymization-mapping-redacted.json (JSON), README.md (markup describing fields & timezones).

If that timeline works for MedixOne/Hawk, we'll proceed. If you need a different set of sample days, tell us which dates and we'll swap them in.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: auth_session_sample.csv (CSV stub), pseudonymization-mapping-redacted.json (JSON stub), README.md (text)
